brief:
Israel's ambassador to the United States said Thursday that his soldier son was struck by a car at a checkpoint in the occupied West Bank. The ambassador said his son was in critical condition following the attack, which he attributed to a Palestinian driver who rammed the vehicle into him, according to Al-Monitor.

The ambassador did not provide additional details about the incident or his son's prognosis.
dek: Israel's ambassador to the United States said Thursday that his soldier son was fighting for his life after a Palestinian attacker rammed his car into him at a checkpoint in the occupied West Bank.
title: Israeli ambassador's son critically injured in West Bank car-ramming attack
